text:
mara: runtime-alert: suspicious pod on prod-eu1 flagged by host-policy scanner — privileged=true + hostPath mounts to /var/run/docker.sock and /proc. Pod: payments-ingress-77d9 (ns: payments). Seen bind to /proc/1/ns/mnt in container logs. Please triage.

alerts-bot: [Automated] Severity: HIGH — Rule: hostpath-privileged-detect. Event: https://k8s-console/cluster/prod-eu1/pods/payments-ingress-77d9 :fire_engine:

ryan-oncall: ACK. Cordoning node now (10.2.8.41) and evicting pod. Pls avoid redeploys to that node. :lock:

mara: Node is prod-eu1-node-5 (10.2.8.41). Image reported: registry.quay.redwood/release/ing-py:1.2.3, digest sha256:abcd1234ef.. Not in our signed-manifest list.

jamie: quick grep of kubelet logs shows an exec at 12:34Z: `nsenter -t 1 -m -u -i -n -p` inside container. Fwiw that looks like an attempt to access host namespaces. Sending extracted container logs to /tmp/forensics-179800.

linh: Are we doing image signature verification at admission? IIRC we rotated cosign keys last month. Checking KMS/cosign logs.

alex: Registry lookup: image is unsigned. Not on production allowlist. Who pushed this?

mara: Pulling audit trail — one moment.

linh: Audit webhook shows `create` for that pod at 12:30:17Z by system:serviceaccount:ci:builder (IP 35.201.4.9). That service account triggered from CI pipeline `ci-release/ingress-prod`.

alex: KMS logs show a signing request at 12:29 from a short-lived principal tied to `ci-runner`. Key used was deprecated-key-2024, usage logged. Looks like CI used an old key or a mistaken pipeline configured to allow prod pushes.

ryan-oncall: Node cordoned and pod evicted. We've captured container filesystem tarball and kubelet logs to `s3://forensics/179800/`. No other pods on node show the same exec pattern. Starting node rebuild plan.

jamie: Also confirmed pod spec had `hostPID: true` and `hostNetwork: true` plus `securityContext: privileged: true`. That's a lot of blast radius. Need to find RBAC path that allowed the CI SA to create that spec.

linh: Running `kubectl auth can-i --as=system:serviceaccount:ci:builder create pods -n payments` against prod cluster shows allowed because of rolebinding `ci-deployers-prod` bound to `ci:builder`. That binding should not exist for prod — looks like a mistaken upgrade in infra repo.

mara: Immediate containment actions proposed: 1) revoke `ci:builder` token (ops) 2) remove `ci-deployers-prod` binding 3) rotate deprecated-key-2024 in KMS and disable short-lived principals 4) add OPA/admission rule to block hostPID/hostNetwork/privileged in prod 5) scan node fs for indicators.

ryan-oncall: I've filed IT ticket IT-5087 to revoke tokens and listed node rebuild. Marking as actioned: cordon, evict, capture. Will update incident channel.

alex: Initiating KMS key rotation and disabling deprecated-key-2024. Also creating a temporary policy to require cosign signatures referenced to our production key.

linh: Forensics: starting YARA scans + static checks on `s3://forensics/179800/`. Initial file hashes don't match any known malware but there are two suspicious cron-like entries and a small binary calling `nsenter`. Saving timeline to https://redwood.kb/forensics/179800.

jamie: Short-term mitigations I can push: admission webhook rule that rejects pods in `prod-*` with `hostPID: true` or `hostNetwork: true` or `privileged: true`. Also enable image signature enforcement for prod namespaces. I'll prepare PR and a canary rollout in prod pre-prod node pool.

mara: Great. Also need comms: legal and compliance notified, and product leadership. I'm drafting an internal incident note.

alex: I'll own the admission webhook PR and coordinate with devex to add exception workflow for emergencies.

ryan-oncall: I'll own token revocation and node rebuild. ETA 2h for rebuild.

linh: I'll own the forensic analysis and will publish an initial timeline in 3h.

mara: Scheduling 14:00 sync to confirm mitigations and decide severity/SEV level. TL;DR: suspected container escape attempt via misconfigured CI pushing an unsigned image + RBAC binding allowing privileged pod creation. Pod removed and node isolated; tokens and KMS key being rotated; admission and audit tightening in flight. :eyes: :white_check_mark:

alex: Quick note — we should also add an alert for any future pod creation in prod with host mounts or privileged set to true. I'll add that to Redwood monitoring.

jamie: agreed. Adding `prod-host-privileged-create` alert with Pager duty to sec-oncall.

mara: thanks all — keep updates in this thread.
